QuestInfo.name: The Transformation Potion
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies wants to see you. What's happening?
QuestInfo.1: 10 Boogies told you to see #bSophia at the General Store#k. She's is studying in Alchemy, and 10 Boogies wants to know if there is any way to enhance the Transformation Potion. This could be entertaining!
QuestInfo.2: You asked Sophia if there is any way to enhance the Transformation Potion.

0.0: Hello? Umm...do you have some time, #h0#? Can I ask you for a favor?

yes.0: I used to have lots of Transformation Potions, but they wear off too quickly...and I drank them all. Please go to Sophia and find out if there is way to enhance the potion.

no.0: Honestly, the most fun I've ever had was when I transformed myself into an Orange Mushroom. I want to make a Transformation Potion, so I can enjoy bouncing around again. If you help me, I'll give you some.

1.0: Oh, hello! Would you like some tea? I just got a lovely new flavor in, 'Sleepywood Dreams'.
1.1: Wait...you want to know about Transformation Potions? I think you look fine just the way you are!

yes.0: Sure, enhancing the Transformation Potion should be easy! I even kept all my notes from that day of alchemy class. Let me just find my notes...

default.0: Hurry! Go see Sophia and ask her how to enhance the Transformation Potion!

item.0: Did 10 Boogies ask you to give me something? Or did 10 Boogies forget to give it to you in the first place?

lost.0: My goodness, how could you lose my Transformation Potion? Thank goodness I found it! Take it to Sophia straight away.
